topic.reason: מחר יום חמישי של השבוע הראשון אחרי חופשת סוכות. לפי לוח החופשות של משרד החינוך (כפי שפורסם במסמך לוח חופשות תשפ״ז של המרכז הקהילתי rng.org.il, נקרא היום): ״הלימודים יתחדשו ביום ראשון, כ״ג בתשרי תשפ״ז 4 באוקטובר 2026״, ולפני כן חופשה מערב יום כיפור (20.9) ועד סוף סוכות (3.10). אחרי כמעט שבועיים בבית הרבה הורים רואים שוב היצמדות ובכי בשער. הנושא ראשון ברשימה, בעונה, ויש בקטלוג ספר שמתאים לקישור בהודעה. מעונות יום לגילאי 0 עד 3 עובדים לפי לוח אחר (לוח חופשות מעונות יום של משרד החינוך), לכן הטקסט אומר ״אחרי החגים״ ולא תאריך. רגישות: החבילה נכתבה ב-7.10, אז הטון רך ובלי מילים של פחד או סכנה.

voice.note: קול ברירת מחדל: 0 מתוך 15 דוגמאות מאושרות. נכתב לפי הקול המתועד ב-lumebook-hebrew-voice ועדיין לא מכויל לירין. אין עדיין עריכות של ירין ללמוד מהן.

sources.title: After being home sick for four days, my daughter, who loved school, now cries when I leave her. What can I do?
sources.quote: If a child is sick and misses school for 4 days, it's not uncommon that going back to school is causing her some stress. ... It sounds as if her absence interrupted a healthy adjustment to school
sources.supports: Upset can return after days away from school. The article is about an illness absence; applied here to the holiday break.

sources.title: How to Ease Your Child's Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: American Academy of Pediatrics, HealthyChildren.org (Wendy Sue Swanson, MD, FAAP; updated 5/11/2026)
sources.quote: keep the goodbye short and sweet. ... If you linger, the transition time does too. So will the anxiety. ... "I'll be back after nap time and before afternoon snack."
sources.supports: Short goodbyes; tell the return time in terms of the child's day.

sources.title: Separation Anxiety
sources.quote: Don't leave without saying goodbye. Sneaking away makes a child worry that you might leave at any time.
sources.supports: Say goodbye, do not sneak away.

sources.title: What Comes Next? Back to Child Care Following Shelter-in-Place
sources.quote: Read books about child care. If you're able to access a public library (or online stories), choose a few titles about going to preschool or child care.
sources.supports: Reading stories about going to child care helps a return. The article is about returning after lockdown; applied here to returning after a break.

claims.wording_he: ואחרי החגים שוב קשה לי לעזוב לך את היד
claims.supports: Going back after days away can bring stress back (illness absence, applied to the holiday break). Said as one child's experience, not every child.

claims.wording_he: אני בעצם שואל מתי את באה לקחת אותי?
claims.supports: Imagined child voice; rests on AAP's advice to tell the child when you return.

claims.supports: Tell the return time as an event the child understands (after nap and snack).

claims.supports: Keep the goodbye short; do not sneak away.

claims.supports: Story resolution in the child's voice; no factual claim.

claims.supports: ZERO TO THREE suggests reading stories about going to child care. That the story is personalised is our wording.

versions.conversion_rationale: ״אמא״ לבד בשקופית הראשונה עוצר כמו הודעה מהילד, והשקופית השנייה מזהה בדיוק את ההורה של השבוע הזה (נכנס לבד בספטמבר וחזר להיצמד). שני הפתרונות פשוטים למחר בבוקר, והסיפור נסגר באיסוף. מילת הקוד בוקר חוזרת על המילה מהפתיח.

sources.title: How to Ease Your Child's Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: American Academy of Pediatrics, HealthyChildren.org (Wendy Sue Swanson, MD, FAAP; updated 5/11/2026)
sources.quote: Even though we are often reminded that our children stop crying within minutes of our leave-taking ... keep the goodbye short and sweet. ... If you linger, the transition time does too. So will the anxiety.
sources.supports: Crying often stops within minutes of the parent leaving; keep goodbyes short because lingering lengthens the transition.

sources.title: What Comes Next? Back to Child Care Following Shelter-in-Place
sources.quote: Think about creating a special good-bye routine. For example, you can give your child a kiss on the palm to "hold" all day long. Or, the two of you can sing a special song together before you leave. ... Read books about child care.
sources.supports: A special goodbye routine such as a song; reading books about child care. The article is about returning after lockdown; applied here to returning after a break.

sources.title: How to Ease Your Child's Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: American Academy of Pediatrics, HealthyChildren.org (Wendy Sue Swanson, MD, FAAP; updated 5/11/2026)
sources.quote: keep the goodbye short and sweet. ... If you linger, the transition time does too. So will the anxiety. ... "I'll be back after nap time and before afternoon snack."
sources.supports: AAP: tell the return time in terms of the child's day (after nap, before snack); keep the goodbye short.

sources.title: Separation Issues in Young Children
sources.quote: Try to keep the moment of separation as brief as possible. Dragging it out tends to make it more difficult. ... Don't say you're going to be back in five minutes if it's going to be five hours.
sources.supports: Be honest about when you return; keep the separation brief.

sources.title: Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: Nemours KidsHealth (reviewed by Leah J. Orchinik, PhD, March 2023)
sources.quote: It's important to make sure that you return when you have promised to. ... Eventually, your child will be able to remember that you always return after you leave, and that will be comfort enough while you're gone.
sources.supports: Return when promised; over time the child remembers that the parent comes back.

sources.title: Separation Anxiety
sources.quote: Don't leave without saying goodbye. Sneaking away makes a child worry that you might leave at any time.
sources.supports: Say goodbye, do not sneak away.

sources.title: What Comes Next? Back to Child Care Following Shelter-in-Place
sources.quote: Read books about child care. If you're able to access a public library (or online stories), choose a few titles about going to preschool or child care.
sources.supports: Reading stories about going to child care. The article is about returning after lockdown; applied here to returning after a break.

sources.title: After being home sick for four days, my daughter, who loved school, now cries when I leave her. What can I do?
sources.quote: If a child is sick and misses school for 4 days, it's not uncommon that going back to school is causing her some stress. ... It sounds as if her absence interrupted a healthy adjustment to school
sources.supports: Days away can interrupt a good adjustment and make the return stressful. The article is about an illness absence; applied here to the holiday break.

sources.title: Separation Anxiety
sources.quote: Don't leave without saying goodbye. Sneaking away makes a child worry that you might leave at any time. ... Have a routine for leaving the house to go to child care.
sources.supports: A routine for leaving; say goodbye, do not sneak away.

sources.title: How to Ease Your Child's Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: American Academy of Pediatrics, HealthyChildren.org (Wendy Sue Swanson, MD, FAAP; updated 5/11/2026)
sources.quote: If you linger, the transition time does too. So will the anxiety. ... "I'll be back after nap time and before afternoon snack."
sources.supports: Lingering lengthens the transition; tell the return in terms of the child's day.

sources.title: Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: Nemours KidsHealth (reviewed by Leah J. Orchinik, PhD, March 2023)
sources.quote: It's important to make sure that you return when you have promised to. ... Eventually, your child will be able to remember that you always return after you leave, and that will be comfort enough while you're gone.
sources.supports: Return when promised; the child comes to remember that the parent always returns.

sources.title: What Comes Next? Back to Child Care Following Shelter-in-Place
sources.quote: Read books about child care. If you're able to access a public library (or online stories), choose a few titles about going to preschool or child care.
sources.supports: Reading stories about going to child care when returning. The article is about returning after lockdown; applied here to returning after a break.

claims.supports: A return after days away can be stressful in itself, without a problem at school. Paid off on slide 3. Source is about illness absence.

claims.supports: Child Mind Institute: after missing days it's not uncommon that going back causes stress; the absence interrupted a healthy adjustment. Illness absence, applied to the holiday break.

sources.title: Separation Issues in Young Children
sources.quote: Try to keep the moment of separation as brief as possible. Dragging it out tends to make it more difficult. ... Having a caretaker leave can feel genuinely scary to kids, so you don't want to downplay that. ... Gradually practicing separating in small doses can help your child build up the feeling of being able to accomplish it.
sources.supports: The fear is real and should not be downplayed; keep the separation brief; practise separating in small doses (the article's examples include taking out the garbage).

sources.title: What Comes Next? Back to Child Care Following Shelter-in-Place
sources.quote: Think about creating a special good-bye routine. For example, you can give your child a kiss on the palm to "hold" all day long. ... Read books about child care.
sources.supports: A kiss on the palm as a goodbye routine; reading books about child care. The article is about returning after lockdown; applied here to a regular kindergarten morning.

sources.title: Separation Anxiety
sources.publisher: Nemours KidsHealth (reviewed by Leah J. Orchinik, PhD, March 2023)
sources.quote: Practice being apart from each other, and introduce new people and places slowly. ... It's important to make sure that you return when you have promised to.
sources.supports: Practise being apart; return when promised.
